name: get-environment-release-plans
description: Get environment release plans, reusable progressive-release recipes. Beta API. Without releasePlanKey: a page ordered by creation time with totalCount; when hasMore is true, pass nextOffset as offset. With releasePlanKey: one plan with its phases (clauses and steps), metrics, randomizationUnit, advancementMode, and cleanupBehavior.

environmentKey.description: Environment key. If the user hasn't named one, ask; don't guess.

offset.description: Only without releasePlanKey. Pass nextOffset from the previous page.

projectKey.description: Project key. If the user hasn't named one, ask; don't guess.

releasePlanKey.description: Get one plan. Omit to list plans.
